scope: Conditional sustained demand for the measured v51 27B Q8 MTP5 workload and unchanged current 3-byte pad format. Not an attainable speed prediction or a universal model ceiling.
limits: Pads preloaded before timing can support bursts; this is sustained replenishment demand after stock runs down.
MTP acceptance and workload changes can change bytes per generated token.
Padding demand counts only values actually consumed; excludes unconsumed values in whole shipments, tags, headers and transport overhead.
Only incoming reply plus incoming pad payload is combined. The outgoing request direction is not added.
A remote pad generator alone leaves this transfer requirement if pads still arrive at the phone over the same connection.
